manual_basis: Installed SIMLOX manual physical pp338-339 and 439-441 describes task-referenced ItemRepair selection through MaintenanceAllocation and says an ItemRepair row with no task reference is always active. The cited source must be verified against native event, item and stock evidence.
controlled_delta: The referenced control is byte-identical to I01.var05 AIR_NONE. The unreferenced candidate clears ItemRepair.DIRPTID from I01-LRU-DIRP to null and changes only ProblemDescription. Control.APID AIR_NONE, MaintenanceAllocation AIR_NONE/LRU-CM/BASE/<NONE>, one local spare, all task metadata, aircraft, failure mode, replacement, schedule, seed and horizon stay fixed. No ItemReorder row exists.

pre_run_hypotheses.referenced: The sealed prior I01.var05 native run observed no failed-LRU direct repair or return to stock and warning #241. Re-run it as a same-stage control; do not treat prior report aggregates as evidence of failed-item conservation.
pre_run_hypotheses.unreferenced: If no-task-reference ItemRepair is always active here, the failed LRU should receive a DIRP event after arrival, complete after its fixed one-hour duration, and return to local stock despite AIR_NONE selecting <NONE> for the referenced category. The two arms should retain identical aircraft failure, spare replacement and readiness events up to that difference.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: The converter may reject the combination, the native engine may suppress the unreferenced record, warning #241 may persist, or item/stock flow may differ. Preserve those outcomes as diagnostics rather than accepting the manual rule by assumption.

acceptance_gates: Independent pre-run source and hypothesis review; immutable hashes before native execution
Two fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
23 authored tables round-trip exactly, converter errors zero, valid nonempty output and report
Individual failed-LRU arrival, direct repair, stock return or absence reconciled with item/stock ledger and 72-bin report
Raw artifact SHA-256 seals, author assertions, separate read-only replay and final static review
limits: This isolates a no-task-reference ItemRepair record under the AIR_NONE maintenance POINT in one E01-derived LRU/WS model; it does not prove all no-task-reference allocation rows or stations.
The model has no ItemReorder path, so complete <NONE> procurement and physical failed-item conservation remain unaccepted.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
